title: Barcelona’s 2024 Superblocks Cut Traffic 30% but Cafés Lose 9% Footfall
caption: Superblocks slash cars, but cafés suffer. Vehicle counts fell 30% to 840,000 per day, a drop of 360,000 from the 2023 baseline. Weekend café visits declined 9% across the new superblock districts. The 40% rise in pedestrians shows streets are busier, yet fewer customers reach cafés, proving that traffic cuts do not automatically boost local hospitality. Save this post to revisit the data.
